t1.text: Midterm Tracker — three layout options for the National view

n1.text: All numbers on these boards are SAMPLE DATA for layout only — not results. Party colors: D blue #3A6FB7 / R red #C0463F / called = solid, leading = hatched + translucent.

n2.text: Option B trades density for readability: one chamber per screen-height, suited to reading on a phone while the TV is on.

n3.text: Option C keeps map and table in view together; table filters drive the map. Best for watching a shortlist of races.
